history.text: Port Royal, the capital of French Acadia, falls in a siege by British forces.
history.title: Siege of Port Royal (1710)

photo.caption: Desert elephant (Loxodonta africana) spraying sand on herself while guarding her sleeping baby. She has covered the baby with a branch. In Damaraland, Namibia

culture.title: 1903 World Series
